summary: DanCo Services does concrete repair, asphalt paving and pavement markings from New Caney, Texas.

groups.title: Concrete Paving and Panel Replacement
groups.summary: Not every concrete problem can be patched. Damaged panels, cracked sections, settled areas, broken edges, and surface failures often need full panel replacement to hold up under commercial traffic long-term. DanCo evaluates each damaged section individually — repairing where patching will last, and replacing panels where it won’t.

groups.title: Sidewalk, Curb, and Trip Hazard Repair
groups.summary: Uneven sidewalks, damaged curbs, and trip hazards are a liability risk on any commercial property.
groups.intro: Uneven sidewalks, damaged curbs, and trip hazards are a liability risk on any commercial property. DanCo repairs and replaces sidewalks, curbs, and pedestrian paths, correcting uneven panel transitions and settled sections along walkways, entrances, and parking areas.

groups.title: Full-Depth Concrete Repair
groups.summary: When a section of concrete has failed below the surface, DanCo performs full-depth repair: sawcutting and demoing the damaged section, hauling off debris, reviewing the subgrade and base, adding doweling or rebar reinforcement where needed, forming, placing and finishing new concrete, and curing it properly before the site is cleaned up and reopened.

groups.title: Concrete Repair for Commercial Properties
groups.summary: Every property has different traffic patterns, drainage conditions, and tenant considerations.
groups.intro: Every property has different traffic patterns, drainage conditions, and tenant considerations, so we scope repairs around how the site is actually used rather than a one-size-fits-all spec.

groups.title: Asphalt Overlay and Resurfacing
groups.summary: An asphalt overlay adds a new layer of asphalt over an existing surface and is often the most cost-effective option when the base underneath is still structurally sound but the surface has aged, cracked, or worn down.

about.title: Repairs built for the ground they sit on.
text: DanCo crews understand local soil conditions and engineer repairs accordingly, not just patch over the symptom.

The team brings years of experience in construction, project management and commercial property services, and DanCo is more than a paving company, handling utilities, drainage, fencing and tree removal too.
Every damaged section is evaluated individually, and clients get transparent timelines, regular updates and one dedicated point of contact.
